fields.name: salutationOptions
fields.label: Salutation Options
fields.description: Add one choice per item (e.g., Mr, Mrs, Ms, Mx, Dr). If left empty, the dropdown defaults to Mr, Mrs, Ms, Mx, Dr.

fields.name: countryPlaceholder
fields.label: Country Field Placeholder
fields.description: Label of the blank first option in the country dropdown. Inline layout; Modal uses it as the text input placeholder.

fields.name: consentMessage
fields.label: Consent Notice Text
fields.value: I would like to receive updates and offers from Capella Hotel Group via email or other electronic channels. View our Privacy Policy.

fields.name: enableHCaptcha
fields.label: Enable hCaptcha
fields.description: Require hCaptcha verification before submitting the form.

fields.name: infoText
fields.label: Info Text
fields.description: Optional information shown directly below the form title. Leave blank to omit it.
fields.value: Submission in non-English is not supported

fields.name: errorMessage
fields.label: General Error Message
fields.description: Shown under the submit button when the submission fails for any reason not covered by a field message. Inline layout only.
fields.value: Sorry, something went wrong. Please try again.

fields.name: salutationError
fields.label: Salutation Error Message
fields.description: Shown when no salutation is selected. Inline layout only.

fields.name: firstNameError
fields.label: First Name Error Message
fields.description: Shown when the first name is blank or contains characters other than letters. Inline layout only.

fields.name: lastNameError
fields.label: Last Name Error Message
fields.description: Shown when the last name is blank or contains characters other than letters. Inline layout only.

fields.name: countryError
fields.label: Country Error Message
fields.description: Shown when no country is selected. Inline layout only.

fields.name: countryInvalidError
fields.label: Country Invalid Error Message
fields.description: No longer used (country is a dropdown); kept so existing authored content keeps its cell order.

fields.name: emailRequiredError
fields.label: Email Required Error Message
fields.description: Shown when the email is blank. Inline layout only.
fields.value: Please enter a valid email address.

fields.name: emailFormatError
fields.label: Email Format Error Message
fields.description: Shown when the email does not follow the user@domain.com format. Inline layout only.
fields.value: Please enter a valid email address.

fields.name: consentError
fields.label: Consent Error Message
fields.description: Shown when the consent checkbox is not ticked. Inline layout only.
fields.value: Please accept the terms to continue.

fields.name: captchaRequiredError
fields.label: CAPTCHA Required Error Message
fields.description: Shown when hCaptcha is enabled and has not been completed. Inline layout only.

fields.name: captchaUnavailableError
fields.label: CAPTCHA Unavailable Error Message
fields.description: Shown when hCaptcha cannot be loaded. Inline layout only.
fields.value: CAPTCHA is unavailable. Please try again later.

fields.name: countryValidationUnavailableError
fields.label: Country Validation Unavailable Error Message
fields.description: Shown when the country cannot be validated. Inline layout only.
fields.value: Country validation is unavailable. Please try again later.

fields.name: successEyebrow
fields.label: Eyebrow
fields.description: Small label above the thank-you title. Inline layout only.

fields.name: successHeading
fields.label: Title
fields.description: Each paragraph renders as its own title line. Inline layout only.

fields.name: successMessage
fields.label: Body Text
fields.description: Thank-you message shown after a successful sign-up. Inline layout only.
fields.value: You have successfully joined our mailing list. Look out for the latest news and exclusive offers from Capella.

fields.name: successButtonLabel
fields.label: Button Label
fields.description: Label of the button that closes the thank-you modal. Inline layout only.
